premises.text: A billion existing AC units are not addressable by smart thermostats designed for central heating systems
Sensible pod makes those ACs app-controllable and applies efficiency, occupancy, and lifestyle algorithms that cut energy ~40%
premises.evidence_span: not only we can control it via an app, we can actually save a huge amount of energy

premises.text: Commercial offer prices a $160 base kit and $80 per additional conditioned unit
premises.evidence_span: for each additional air conditioner you have in your home or office, it's another $80

value.text: Any air conditioner becomes smart with large energy and bill savings
value.evidence_span: We make any air conditioner smart

causal_links.evidence_span: there are one billion of these kinds of air conditioners
